title: 薄膜電晶體顯示背板
summary: 從像素開關、閘介面到面板驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Pixel switching and Gate interface to Panel acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 像素開關：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「背板控制與發光材料是不同功能」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Backplane control and light emission are different functions.
steps.instruction: 畫 TFT、儲存電容和顯示負載，追蹤一列更新。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw TFT, storage capacitor and display load and trace row updating. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 背板控制與發光材料是不同功能；像素保持需要低關斷漏電。
steps.observationEn: Backplane control and light emission are different functions; Pixel hold requires low off-state leakage.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 TFT 通道直接當成發光層」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating the TFT channel as the emitting layer", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「像素開關」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：背板控制與發光材料是不同功能。

steps.instruction:

steps.instructionEn:
Estimate pixel voltage loss over a frame from hypothetical capacitance/leakage. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a display-pixel storage capacitance of 1 pF, constant leakage of 1 pA and hold time of 16 ms. Voltage-loss magnitude ΔV=IΔt/C=0.016 V=16 mV; doubling leakage gives 32 mV. This constant-leakage model is not an IGZO-panel specification; illumination, bias stress and parasitic coupling need separate evaluation.

steps.checkEn:

Worked-example acceptance: Verify 16 mV and the millisecond-to-second conversion; explain that time-varying leakage requires integration.

steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Compensation costs circuitry, time or area.
steps.instruction: 畫感測 Vth 的像素電路與補償後殘差。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a threshold-sensing pixel circuit and residual error. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 補償需付出電路、時間或面積成本；補償讀取本身需要穩定參考。
steps.observationEn: Compensation costs circuitry, time or area; Compensation sensing needs stable references.
steps.failure: 若採用「軟體補償可完全消除任何硬體失效」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming software compensation removes every hardware failure", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「驅動補償」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：補償需付出電路、時間或面積成本。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Drive compensation diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Compensation costs circuitry, time or area.

steps.title: 驅動補償：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「軟體補償可完全消除任何硬體失效」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Assuming software compensation removes every hardware failure.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「驅動補償」成果，先指出錯誤主張「軟體補償可完全消除任何硬體失效」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：補償讀取本身需要穩定參考。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Drive compensation artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Assuming software compensation removes every hardware failure". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Compensation sensing needs stable references. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 補償需付出電路、時間或面積成本；補償讀取本身需要穩定參考。
steps.observationEn: Compensation costs circuitry, time or area; Compensation sensing needs stable references.
steps.failure: 若採用「軟體補償可完全消除任何硬體失效」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming software compensation removes every hardware failure", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「驅動補償」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「補償讀取本身需要穩定參考」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Drive compensation, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Compensation sensing needs stable references" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.
